# Fetch all songs by Zoey James and find the least played
artist_id = 9
songs = []
page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.search_songs(artist_id=artist_id, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'len', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print('total_songs_fetched', len(songs))

# compute least play_count
min_play = None
least_candidates = []
for idx, s in enumerate(songs):
    pc = s.get('play_count')
    title = s.get('title')
    if min_play is None or pc < min_play:
        min_play = pc
        least_candidates = [(idx, s)]
    elif pc == min_play:
        least_candidates.append((idx, s))

print('min_play_count', min_play)
print('num_min_candidates', len(least_candidates))
print('first_min_candidate', least_candidates[0][1].get('song_id'), least_candidates[0][1].get('title'))
print('min_candidates_titles', [(c[1].get('song_id'), c[1].get('title')) for c in least_candidates[:10]])

answer_title = least_candidates[0][1].get('title') if least_candidates else None
print('answer_title', answer_title)
